data.message: I commit to 18 tons this month and invite each of you to opt in individually—not an all-or-nothing deal. State your exact intended catch and any conditions. If k choose 18 and others 10, catch=250+8k, stock left=250-8k; next stock is 500 (75%) or 500-16k (25%). Switching adds $8,000 now if fulfilled, but lowers stock left by 8 and the low-recovery stock by 16. All 18 leaves 50, then 500 or 100. Long-run gains aren't guaranteed; intentions aren't binding; other catches need recalculation.
